profile_text.body:
Zscaler is a publicly traded cloud security company (Nasdaq: ZS) that describes itself as a leading cloud enterprise security provider helping global businesses adopt zero trust for secure digital transformation. Its core platform, the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange, is designed to provide organizations with a unified framework for securing data, users, and applications across cloud environments. The company also emphasizes support for agent-to-agent interactions and data lineage governance, positioning its platform as relevant to emerging AI-driven enterprise workflows.

On the AI side, Zscaler offers a product tracked as Zscaler AI, which encompasses cloud security AI capabilities, a Security Service Edge platform, data loss prevention, and inspection of AI traffic. The company characterizes its security cloud as the largest of its kind and maintains an ecosystem of partners and integrations intended to support customer deployments. Zscaler holds SEC registration under CIK 0001713683 and no litigation or MCP server entries appear in the currently held facts.
